متفرقات.description: It’s Hedgehog Week here in Sweden. The number of hedgehogs is almost down to half of what it was 12 years ago. To get a clearer picture of where they live and where they don’t, WWF launched the Hedgehog Week project back in 2024. Anyone can report a sighting, or the lack of one, and the data goes to a species database for researchers to work with.
